test_title: PYST 33: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 14 March 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

He said to me, "Please drop me home in your car."

options.text: I told him to drop me home in my car.
He requested me to drop him home in my car.
He asked me to drop him home in your car.
He said to me please drop me home in your car.

solution:
The correct sentence is "**He requested me to drop him home in my car.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• There are a few things to keep in mind when changing a sentence from direct speech to indirect speech.
 
• The reporting verb "**said to**" changes to "requeste
